Theme.Name: My theme
Theme.Hint: The theme on this computer. "Table default" follows the GM's choice; "Off" shows Foundry's own interface. Changes apply immediately.

Size.Name: Sidebar tab size
Size.Hint: Large uses 40 px tab icons like the original FlexUI; compact keeps the tabs close to Foundry's own size.

Font.Name: Directory text size
Font.Hint: Text size and row height in the Actors, Items, Journal and other sidebar lists.

Lightweight.Name: Lightweight textures
Lightweight.Hint: Draw the sidebar panel and the chat parchment with CSS instead of the original artwork's images (the parchment alone is a 2 MB image). Turn on for slow connections or weak computers; tab icons and buttons keep their artwork.

Areas.Name: Styled areas
Areas.Label: Choose areas
Areas.Hint: Pick which parts of the interface FlexUI Revived styles on this computer, for example to leave the chat to another module.

DefaultTheme.Name: Table default theme
DefaultTheme.Hint: The theme for every player who leaves "My theme" on "Table default".

ArtSource.Name: Artwork
ArtSource.Hint: FlexUI Revived ships no images. Automatic uses the original FlexUI's artwork when that module is installed (it does not need to be active) and CSS textures otherwise. Custom uses the folder chosen under "Custom artwork", filling gaps from the original if installed.

CustomArt.Name: Custom artwork
CustomArt.Label: Choose folder
CustomArt.Hint: A folder of your own images named like the original FlexUI's (icon_chat.webp, main_panel.png, ...). Used when Artwork is set to Custom folder.

Notify.OriginalActive: The original FlexUI module is active. It was made for Foundry v11 and breaks this version's interface, so FlexUI Revived switched its stylesheets off for this session. Deactivate it in Manage Modules; keep it installed if you want its artwork.
Notify.OriginalMissing: FlexUI Revived is set to use the original FlexUI's artwork, but that module is not installed. Install it (it does not need to be active) or choose another Artwork setting.

Areas.Title: FlexUI Revived: styled areas
Areas.Intro: Unticked areas keep Foundry's (or another module's) look on this computer.

tabs.Name: Sidebar tabs
tabs.Hint: The tab buttons on the right edge, with the theme's icons.

panel.Name: Sidebar panel
panel.Hint: The background and frame behind the sidebar's contents.

chat.Name: Chat
chat.Hint: Parchment chat messages, speaker names, whisper and blind labels, the message box and roll mode buttons.

directories.Name: Directories
directories.Hint: Search boxes, create buttons, folders, settings tab buttons and directory text size.

combat.Name: Combat tracker
combat.Hint: Begin and end combat buttons and the active combatant highlight.

controls.Name: Scene controls
controls.Hint: The layer and tool buttons on the left.

navigation.Name: Scene navigation
navigation.Hint: The scene buttons along the top.

windows.Name: Window title bars
windows.Hint: Title bars of sheets and other windows. Off by default because many systems and modules style their own.

CustomArt.Title: FlexUI Revived: custom artwork
CustomArt.Intro: Choose a folder in your Foundry data containing any of the images below, named the same way (any of webp, png, jpg, avif, gif or svg). Each image found replaces that part of every theme; anything missing falls back to the original FlexUI's artwork if it is installed, otherwise to CSS.
CustomArt.FolderHint: Folders in your user data only. S3 buckets and other file sources are not listed.
CustomArt.NotSelected: Set Artwork to "Custom folder" in the module settings to use these images.
CustomArt.Saved: Custom artwork saved: {found} of {total} images found.
